headword: {塵|ちり}も{積|つ}もれば{山|やま}となる
reading: ちりもつもればやまとなる
gloss: many a little makes a mickle

definitions.gloss: many a little makes a mickle, small things accumulate to become big
definitions.explanation: Even small amounts, when accumulated over time, can become something significant.

examples.japanese: 「{塵|ちり}も{積|つ}もれば{山|やま}となる」⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since 'little by little adds up,' I save a little every day.

examples.japanese: {塵|ちり}も{積|つ}もれば{山|やま}となる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いう→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧、⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つながる→繋がる：01963_tsunagaru⟧。
examples.english: As the saying goes, small efforts lead to big results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。{塵|ちり}も{積|つ}もれば{山|やま}となる⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: I don't waste even one yen. After all, every little bit counts.

notes:
LITERAL MEANING: "Even dust, if it accumulates, becomes a mountain."

USAGE: Used to encourage small but consistent efforts, especially in saving money, studying, or working toward goals.

NUANCE: Can be used positively (encouraging consistent effort) or as a warning (small bad habits or expenses also add up).

SHORTER FORM: Sometimes abbreviated as {塵|ちり}も{積|つ}もれば or just referenced as 「⟦{塵|ちり}つも→塵つも：noentry⟧」 in casual speech.

ENGLISH EQUIVALENTS:
- "Many a little makes a mickle"
- "Little by little adds up"
- "Every little bit counts"
- "Take care of the pennies and the pounds will take care of themselves"
